Question: Show each asset and its open work order count.

rank_trace.sql:
SELECT a.asset_id, COUNT(wo.work_order_id) AS open_work_order_count  
   FROM assets a  
   LEFT JOIN work_orders wo ON a.asset_id = wo.asset_id AND wo.status = 'open'  
   GROUP BY a.asset_id;

SELECT a.asset_id, COUNT(*) AS open_work_order_count  
   FROM assets a  
   LEFT JOIN work_orders wo ON a.asset_id = wo.asset_id  
   WHERE wo.status = 'open' OR wo.status IS NULL  
   GROUP BY a.asset_id;
